summary: João Pedro is out until around the New Year (Alonso). That keeps the door open for Estêvão; Chelsea's team news is still to come.

claims.text: Alonso: not ready to train with the squad; 'we need to see game by game how he's feeling'.

claims.text: Alonso: out for at least a few more weeks, now targeting a New Year comeback.
